items.html: And although we explained above that all hairs are drawn from the Gevurot and judgments, nevertheless, relative to ZA they are complete mercies, more than the mercies and Hassadim within ZA. Therefore, from these hairs of Arich Anpin, influence and illumination are drawn to the head of ZA; but they reach only his head alone, and over the rest of his entire body the hairs of Arich Anpin do not cover him, as they cover Aba and Ima. And this is the secret of "And I am a bare man."
